description: This file implements a strong type library in C++14/17/20, providing type safety and various type modifiers such as equality, ordering, streamability, and arithmetic operations. It defines a 'type' template class with multiple traits and modifiers, and includes support for formatting and hashing.
external_files: conditionally included if STRONG_HAS_STD_FORMAT is enabled
conditionally included if STRONG_HAS_FMT_FORMAT is enabled
published: strong::support for std::hash and std::formatter specializations

classes.name: type
classes.description: A template class representing a strong type with various traits and modifiers, supporting construction, value access, and swap operations.

classes.name: uninitialized_t
classes.description: A tag type used to create uninitialized instances of strong types.

classes.name: default_constructible
classes.description: A trait indicating support for default construction.

classes.name: equality
classes.description: A trait providing equality operators for strong types.

classes.name: ordered
classes.description: A trait providing ordering operators for strong types.

classes.name: semiregular
classes.description: A trait indicating the type is semiregular (copyable, movable, default constructible).

classes.name: regular
classes.description: A trait indicating the type is regular (semiregular + equality).

classes.name: unique
classes.description: A trait indicating the type has unique ownership semantics.

classes.name: pointer
classes.description: A trait providing pointer-like operations for strong types.

classes.name: arithmetic
classes.description: A trait providing arithmetic operators for strong types.

classes.name: bitarithmetic
classes.description: A trait providing bitwise operators for strong types.

classes.name: iterator
classes.description: A trait providing iterator operations for strong types.

classes.name: range
classes.description: A trait providing range-based operations for strong types.

classes.name: convertible_to
classes.description: A trait enabling explicit conversion to other types.

classes.name: implicitly_convertible_to
classes.description: A trait enabling implicit conversion to other types.

classes.name: formattable
classes.description: A trait enabling formatting support for strong types.

classes.name: hashable
classes.description: A trait enabling hash support for strong types.

methods.name: operator<<
methods.description: Stream output operator for strong types.

methods.name: operator>>
methods.description: Stream input operator for strong types.

methods.name: operator+=, -=, *=, /=, %=, &=, |=, ^=, <<=, >>=, etc.
methods.description: Arithmetic and bitwise compound assignment operators.

methods.name: operator->
methods.description: Member access operator for pointer types.

methods.name: operator- (difference)
methods.description: Subtracts two strong types to produce a difference type.

methods.name: operator+=, -=, *=, /=, %=, etc.
methods.description: Modifiers for arithmetic and other operations.
